title: Add JSON output for flush receipts
summary: Add `covenant chain flush-receipts --json` with a stable machine-readable shape so automation can flush local receipts and capture the resulting batch without parsing human output.
expectedFailureModes: Automation depends on human output that changes without schema review.
`--json` prints non-JSON to stdout (warnings, progress text, etc.).
The JSON output omits `batch_id` or `merkle_root`, forcing callers back to human parsing.
nextAction: Continue with the next autonomy backlog item.
